name: LNG-01 Hebrew end to end
expected_outcome: The greeting may be English. From מקיף onward every reply is Hebrew. The plate is saved as 12345678 and the vehicle is shown one field per line. The summary shows windshield and replacement vehicle, 0501234567, and dana@example.com. The closing is Hebrew. After final confirmation, End Node sends the closing with the applicant name, normalized phone, email, and an applicant-facing reference. A UUID-shaped reference is correct and is not internal diagnostic output. The closing does not claim a policy was issued. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: LNG-02 Mid-conversation switch to Hebrew
expected_outcome: The first replies are English. After the applicant writes in Hebrew, the agent continues in Hebrew, including the vehicle presentation for 12345678, and does not revert to English on numeric input. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.
